column3: “Ask them” specifies the final saying; the particle of request is omitted.
“This is” is supplied before the word covenanted with you; promise interprets that word.
“With” and their are supplied, making the nations come with treasures rather than the precious things of all nations coming.
“A ruling” specifies instruction; the particle of request and saying are omitted.
“It touches” condenses his touching with the fold of his garment.
“Ephahs of grain” and baths specify the unnamed measures; expecting is supplied.
“Turn” supplies a verb for the phrase you were not toward Me.
“You” is supplied as the object of blessing.
“That day” is supplied with the second occurrence.
“Royal thrones” pluralizes the throne of kingdoms.
“My” is supplied with the signet ring.
